notes.title: Version 2.0.0 (Free DLC)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope you’re all well!

First of all, we apologize for the big delay in this update. We had to add more content than originally planned to deliver a full version of Scarlet Tower. This includes a new map with new bosses, an item manipulation system (Blacksmith), an additional familiar, and a few other things.

Let’s get into the updates for v2.0.0 Ashen Nightmare.

Scarlet Tower - Ashen Nightmare (v2.0.0)
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/ac7f1f7578ec4841d655dd82c951a9252d5db2c1.png

DLC Price
The first new detail is the price, we decided not to charge for this DLC as a thank you to all the 150,000+ players who purchased Scarlet Tower during its development. All DLC content has been added to the base game as an update. Scarlet Tower will have a small price increase in a few days.

Update Content

 New Equipment System (over 70 pieces of equipment)
 New Enchantment and Reforge System (Blacksmith)
 8 Unique and extremely rare items dropped only by Bosses
 New Hero: Amelia
 New Hero: Crowley
 New Map: Holy Islands
 New Map: Ashen Woods
 +20 New Enemies
 +4 New Bosses
 Over 30 New Passives
 +3 New Familiars
 +10 New World Pickups
 +7 New World Events (Deadly Sins)
 +24 New Achievements
 New Game Mode: Nightmare Mode (12-minute runs, much more challenging)
 General rebalance for all enemies/weapons/abilities
 Rework of character and map selection UI


Equipment System
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/3635a9222547865355e1e8bffcce53d9f72fc4f0.png

The highlight of this update is the Equipment System, each character can equip a set with exclusive bonuses to further enhance hero customization.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/a8564e17726bccf846ca37d4cee5565f19a3dd7b.png

Blacksmith
Boost your equipment's power, swap a stat for another, and if you're lucky, gain a corrupt stat with a significant bonus on your item.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/194439add12cf38571a853607c86dc69716be645.gif

If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave us a review on Steam, it helps us a lot! 🧛‍♀️🙏🏽


Join us on Discord!
https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX


Help us by reporting any bugs you find in the #bug-report channel on Discord!

Thank you very much!
Pyxeralia.

notes.title: Update v1.0
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

After 3 months of work on bug fixes and optimizations, we're going to announce everything about version 1.0 and future updates.

The version 1.0 update will be available on March 25th (Tomorrow).

The focus of this update is to add everything you've requested from Steam, like Steam Cards/Badges/Avatars, significant enemy balancing, and millions of performance improvements. We want version 1.0 to run at 60 FPS on most devices.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/bd027369744d3d0c0c12cb4c17ea4f9d221612cf.gif

 Animated Avatars for Steam profiles!

Languages:

 Native Simplified Chinese translation (Thanks Tracy)
 (New languages coming soon)


General Fixes:

 Audio when selecting interface objects now works correctly.

We hope you'll help us by reporting issues on our Discord (https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX). We'll be monitoring Discord, with priority in the bug reports channel (#bug-reports).

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/692916bfa2eb3fd7084d4d9f7bc900b3427ded43.gif

Upcoming Content

 New Epic Boss
 Equipment System
 Fusion of Heroic Weapons
 New Map
 New Weapons
 New Achievements
 New Fusions


The next major content update will be released shortly after the launch of the Scarlet Tower version 1.0 for Nintendo Switch (Q2 2024).

About Post 1.0

 Now that we won't be in EA anymore, all new updates will be released first in the "Beta" system on Steam, so they can be properly tested before being released to everyone.


Frequently Asked Questions
(Question 1) How many updates will there be for Scarlet Tower in 2024?


 We'll release as many bug/ performance fix updates as necessary for the game to run without bugs and at 60 FPS on most devices.
 We're considering between smaller updates or major content DLCs with post-Scarlet Tower maps. (Your opinion is highly welcome in the comments of this post or our Discord https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX)


(Question 2) Will there be announcements of new games from Pyxeralia in 2024?
Yes, we will announce 2 new games in Q3 2024:


 A Turn-based JRPG, inspired by Final Fantasy Tactics/Breath of Fire IV with some procedural generation and roguelike mechanics (Early Access).

 An Action Platformer inspired by MegamanX/Castlevania (Simultaneous release v1.0 on Nintendo Switch and PC).

notes.title: Bloody Gates Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After 5 long months of work, we're here for our biggest Scarlet Tower update. Let's go through the content list.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/355be085362ae4b5b39eaa5d69f1fee69f6535b0.gif
New world allied NPCs.

News
Maps
Scarlet Bridge
Scarlet Tower

Bosses and Enemies
Vorgron
Vorax (Scarlet Tower)
+ 24 New Enemies

Achievements
8/16 new achievements have been added.

The achievements related to map progression, killing bosses, new weapons and specific enemies will be disabled in this version, as talent instability can significantly favor certain builds. They will be unlocked in the next minor patch, within 1 week.

Weapons
Paladin Shield 
Holy Spear 
Pilgrimage Staff
Holy Scepter 
Templar Shield 
Divine Armor 
Skeleton Staff (Summon Weapon)

Fusions
Shield of Gods
Rebirth Spear
Archangel Staff
Clairvoyance Scepter
Faith Armor
Impenetrable Shield

World NPC's
Bloodmancer
Blacksmith
Alchemist
Elementalist
Templar
Priest
Paladin
Necromancer

World Quests
8 World quests have been added.

World Talents
Over 80 new talents have been added to the leveling system.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/6a1c6f1e9012ddeb99d10a45f955f4550c4f2792.png

Each talent family has:

One Mastery
Three Tier 1 talents
Three Tier 2 talents
One Tier 3 talent

You can only acquire higher-tier talents by obtaining the previous ones.

The talent system is tied to weapons. You only unlock a Paladin talent if you have a Paladin weapon, like a Holy Bible.

The new weapon/talent selection screen displays which family that weapon or talent belongs to.

Mastery System

All weapon families have a mastery, which is a parent talent that always appears when you acquire a weapon.

If you obtain a paladin weapon (holy bible), you will instantly gain the paladin mastery.

The mastery does not level up. To strengthen the mastery, you need to acquire skill points during leveling. These skill points are:

Occultism (to increase the character's mastery damage)
Faith (to manipulate some mastery mechanics)
Perseverance (to increase the chance of mastery activation)

Mechanics
Banish System (for Weapons and World Talents at Leveling System)
Curse System (A new corruption leveling system for bridge and tower maps.)

Magic Armor Stat
Spirit Stat (It increases the effect of healing and health shields.)

UI

Map Improvements

Others
We have improved the data collection feedback for eggs and runes in the world.
Several minor interface improvements.

Next Update, Biggest Update Ever: v0.9.3 Bloody Gates (July)

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/355be085362ae4b5b39eaa5d69f1fee69f6535b0.gif

In the "Bloody Gates" Update (v0.9.3), we will introduce the Loyalty to Councils system, such as the Councils of Faith, Occultism, and Perseverance.

Each council will consist of 3 families, represented by 3 NPCs that can be found in the world. Finding and assisting these NPCs will make them join your group, helping you during the run, and they will be called "Allies" (the NPCs shown in the image above).

All weapons in the game will belong to a family. Obtaining a weapon from a family will unlock 8 talents from that family, which can appear as choices during leveling upːsteamthisː.

If you choose the Holy Bible, which belongs to the Paladin family, the following talents will appear as options for you during your leveling:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/427bfee62787daeeb83f884feccb560d61669c90.png

If you choose any minion-summoning weapon, which will be the new weapons added in the Bloody Gates update, the following talents will appear:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/8de077234e5f781f11f72d91beae61972933e9fc.png

The talents have 3 categories:

Grade 1: Unlocked with normal weapons
Grade 2: Unlocked through fusion
Grade 3: Unlocked through the Black Altar challenge

Another new change in the leveling system is the Council Loyalty points, which will appear during leveling to increase the range of possibilities and build customization.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/03e0f53e759673d7ce5e460fe760a2f97ddc74cb.png

Allocating points to Faith will increase your physical strength and health.
Allocating points to Occultism will increase your magical armor and magical damage.
Allocating points to Perseverance will increase your physical armor and critical damage.

In addition to increasing basic stats, the points also drastically alter the mastery of each family. Let's take an example:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/1d02bea0e8af4b3820c66b2a1d7066e6216f2d34.png
Paladin Mastery Talent: Beacon of Light.

All weapons from the Paladin family have a 5% chance to unleash Beacon of Light upon dealing damage.

Beacon of Light emits a light that follows you, dealing 70 area damage per second and healing 20% of the damage dealt to all allies. +10% healing based on damage for each ally (NPC/Minion) on the field. Beacon of Light lasts for 3 seconds.

For every 3 points in Faith, gain +0.5s duration for Beacon of Light.
For every point in Perseverance, gain +0.1% chance to unleash Beacon of Light.
For every point in Occultism, increase Beacon of Light's damage by +10.

There will be 80 new talents in the Loyalty to Councils system.

Other additions in the Bloody Gates update:

- New Maps: Scarlet Tower - Floor 1 and 2 (Possibly 3). With various map mechanics and bosses.
